args.message:
Fix rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The nightly build fails because tests/test_money.py expects banker's
rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) but round_money used ROUND_HALF_UP. Import
and use ROUND_HALF_EVEN to match the documented behavior in FIN-212.

args.head: fix/fin-212-round-half-even
args.title: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, FIN-212)
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212) but `src/money.py` implemented `ROUND_HALF_UP` — despite the docstring already claiming banker's rounding.

## Changes

- `src/money.py`: import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` in `round_money`.

## Behavior

- `2.675` → `2.68` (unchanged; .5 rounds up to even)
- `2.665` → `2.66` (was `2.67` under `ROUND_HALF_UP`; now rounds to even as expected)

## Testing

- CI on this branch passes: run `ci-0001` (commit `08d3cd5986`), including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
